title: Profile form order and household/location fields update
summary: Updated the profile create/edit form layout so contact details appear immediately after Date of Invitation, and added new household/address-style inputs after the spouse field.

items: Moved the contact numbers block to render directly after the Date of Invitation input and before visit entries
Added new fields: Total HouseHold (number), HouseHold Number, Structure Number, House Number, Building Number, Lot & Block Number, Street Name, Village/Subd, Barangay (text), and City/Municipality

Added migration_059_profile_household_location_fields.php to add profiles columns: total_household, household_number, structure_number, house_number, building_number, lot_block_number, street_name, village_subd, barangay_text, city_municipality
Profile model create/update/list/all now saves and selects these fields
Web controller and API controller payload mapping now accept and persist these fields
Profile API responses now include these fields in GET/store/update results
Profile view and profile PDF now render the new household/location fields
Grouped fields into Household information, Structure & property numbers, and Representative information (name + address merged)
Invitation card: 1st/2nd/3rd visits and Invitation received by; placed after Representative address (Date of Invitation remains above contact details)
PAPS Last/First/Middle/Suffix at top; Representative information card (name, 3 contact numbers, address) after Structure & property numbers
migration_061_profiles_representative_name.php; web/API/model persist representative name fields (distinct from PAPS profile name)
migration_064_profile_invitation_fields.php: RSVP, reasons, visit personnel, distribution status, visit status text
Invitation card partials with value-set selects (RSVP, Date Received, Status of Distribution)
Profile::resolveInvitationFieldsForSave(); web gatherProfileData and API buildProfilePayload merge invitation fields
API transformProfile returns invitation_* plus invitation_rsvp_label and invitation_distribution_status_label
